headline: Apple's Aeon internships describe AMS models, LLM workflows and SPICE-based accuracy checks
fact: Apple posted an Aeon Modeling Intern role in Munich on October 1, 2025 for AMS interface models, circuit/measurement comparison, automation and LLM-assisted development. Related role 200690119, posted October 19, 2026, assigns Python/C++ models for SerDes, PLLs, memory interfaces and converters; ML surrogate models trained on circuit simulations and silicon measurements; LLM/agent workflows for specification-to-model generation, code translation, tests and documentation; and automated accuracy checks against SPICE and measurements. It also proposes GPU/parallel acceleration and model-order reduction, with documented accuracy bounds and engineer ownership of correctness. The later recruitment is grouped with the existing Aeon mandate, without changing its original date or asserting completed AI-modeling results.
